title: Hypofractionated Imrt (Vmat-Ra) For Elderly Patients With Newly Diagnosed High Grade Glioma
brief_summary: To assess the effect of IMRT using VMAT rapidarc approach, followed by adjuvant temozolomide on survival and quality of life in elderly, poor performance status patients with newly diagnosed HGG.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged ≥ 70 years
* Karnosky performance status (KPS) ≤60
* Histologically confirmed HGG after tumor biopsy

  * GBM
  * Anaplastic Astrocytoma
  * Anaplastic Oligoastrocytoma
  * Anaplastic Oligodendroglioma without IDH1 mutation and no codeletion 1p19q
* Estimated survival ≥ 3 months.
* Normal liver, Kidney and bone marrow function
* Written informed consent

Exclusion criteria:

* Prior radiation therapy
* Other primary cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
